description:
How to mint the ONE scoped Cloudflare token for the WHOLE deployment. Create
    it ONCE at the start of the domain phase with the full permission set below, use
    it for every Cloudflare step (DNS, SSL mode, redirect check, DNSSEC - and, if you
    want staging locked behind Cloudflare Access, the Access app + policy), then DELETE
    it at the very end. Do NOT create-and-roll a new token per step. The MCP can't
    mint account tokens itself - YOU create it in your own dashboard and hand it over.
name: cloudflare_token_instructions
